narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday is four days. That gives four delays, which is three and one third hours.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But on Monday the Moon sets at ten, and no delay has happened yet.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Only the jumps from one day to the next add a delay.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Count the jumps between days, and not the days themselves.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>To check, add five sixths three times on a clock.

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip counts four days and uses four delays, getting three and one third hours. Monday is the start, so only the jumps add a delay.
